xia-chao opened PR #15214 from xia-chao:fix/tcp-blocking-empty to bytecodealliance:main:

related to #15213; aligning the blocking write path with its docs.
xia-chao requested dicej for a review on PR #15214.
xia-chao removed the review request for wasmtime-wasi-reviewers from PR #15214.

alexcrichton commented on PR #15214:

Can you explain why this is something worth changing? I'm personally quite lost if the vast forest of PRs being sent to tweak and adjust behavior here and there. I feel like code is getting extremely complex with all sorts of special cases, and that's typically indicative of the need to sit down and possibly rethink things rather than having a continuous stream of minor patches to update things.

For example why is this exception specific to TCP as opposed to not applying to all streams? Why isn't the default trait method updated?
:cross_mark: xia-chao closed without merge PR #15214.

pchickey commented on PR #15214:

Also, the entire point of blocking write and flush is that its an exception to the permit system, and always has to accept 4k.

xia-chao commented on PR #15214:

I accept technical review. I do not accept my work being described as "a vast forest of PRs" or "a continuous stream of minor patches." Every PR here took real effort; that framing dismisses it. This is my last comment in this thread.
